The unsigned Windows application directory now carries PostgreSQL, the production Barkpark runtime, reader and PowerShell terminal with reviewed native process cleanup. Paper save/search/restart and forced-host recovery run with developer tools removed from PATH. This draft also adds an offline media observation report: stored physical keys/scopes, unclaimed originals, unsupported regions, uncertainty and potential aliases remain explicit, and every report is partial without deletion or recovery authority.

Media deletion remains unsafe in the carried server: actual DELETE200 removes a locked media row while its exact1,004-byte original survives ordinary restart, unlock and retry404. Managed admission reports zero pending/live/dead writers while those bytes remain, including a held state. A held restart correctly fences writes at recovery_required/zero. These findings motivate the report; this draft does not claim a durable deletion repair or complete inventory.

Bound NTFS root/handle/final path/volume/type/identity, Unicode/empty/multiple-chunk hashes, aliases/reparse/hardlinks/byte limits and sharing/native failures stay explicit. Read sharing denies ordinary writes/renames/new links but permits timestamp changes; final metadata comparison returns changed with no digest/identity. Three changed production modules freshly compile against carried dependencies in1.942s; original6,067runtime files remain exact. This candidate is not adopted by the carried app/HTTP API. rootPR.title: Package Windows runtime and prepare durable media cleanup

upstreamPR.body:
Windows media deletion can commit its row deletion while a locked original survives, leaving no durable operation to retry. This candidate adds an internal local database boundary: capture the raw row and asset variants, delete those database rows, retain pending cleanup and a database key reservation in one transaction. Existing HTTP delete routes are unchanged; original bytes and media effects remain untouched.

Actual Windows release proof passes 151,835 ms / 10 checkpoints: asset refusal and outer rollback preserve row/documents/bytes; abrupt PostgreSQL death before commit restores them without an intent; death after commit preserves the exact pending operation; scoped retries remain pending; raw insert/update/COPY cannot claim its case alias. The ordinary HTTP deletion control still works. All owned processes stop. Three production modules are freshly compiled against the unchanged carried dependencies; original 6,067-file runtime remains exact.

This is a draft integration candidate from the retained Windows runtime baseline 944a57a1e. Main 08080dd26 has advanced 544 commits and changes adjacent contracts. Rebase, a full current dependency build, normal upstream regressions and CI's Elixir 1.18.4 formatter remain required. A local Elixir 1.20.1 scoped build is not that gate. The full doc-budget attempt times out after 60 seconds with unchanged schema-v2.md 7,253 B / 7,200 B overflow; scoped owned-doc limits pass only. No task-service writes were authorized, so task publication/readability has not been established.

Physical writers can write before inserting rows; database reservations do not fence those writes. Native cleanup remains disabled until writer fencing and identity-bound Windows effects are proven. No endpoint/app adoption, admission settlement, installer, real-library/Mac transfer or A2/A3/A5 acceptance. No merge or deployment authorization is inferred.

Source owners and release tests are included in this PR. [Exact build, synthetic fixtures, retained failures and interruption receipts](https://github.com/FRIKKern/barkdown/blob/61b59ad878598c7d5c623cd15b0493b9230594e4/docs/cycles/evidence/C105/review.md) are published in Barkdown. Root verification passes85,558ms; this does not establish current-main integration or physical cleanup.
